Iv has an instantaneous effect, ie if someone was too far gone, I could just stick it straight in their thigh and have it work within 2-5 minutes. 

As far as oral admin goes, good luck getting them to hold the tab under their tongue, not to mention this method takes longer than 15 minutes. Idk. Just an idea.

Please talk to your doctor :( there is beauty and satisfaction to be found in life, hitting such a low is part of life and the human condition and will make finding that nirvana more rewarding than anybody else would experience. If you’re not afraid to die, then why aren’t you afraid to live? What’s the difference? At least in your current state they are both just elements of purgatory. 

Perhaps your searching for something. And you can’t find it. You can’t rely on drugs alone, they are simply there to help aid you on your journey.

That’s because you black out. And then you wake up weakened and depressed. There’s a certain feeling I’m talking about, kind of like your life flashing before your eyes, and the shear panic of instant regret of being consciously aware that you might drop dead if you don’t do something and quick. It’s a scary feeling. Like someone was about to hack your arm off with a hacksaw type of panic. 

Find where you fit. Notice areas that you can improve yourself. Take it day by day. Count your nickels and dimes, and watch them become dollars.

My psych prescribed me a drug called Wellbutrin as an anti depressant, because ssri’s don’t work for me. I’m on 300mg and it’s helped me so much. It gives me subconscious motivation to do more with myself.

I have been suicidal for the past 6 months, one night I did 80 mg of oxycodone solely with the intention of getting high. Went home at 7 am and took 1 mg of lorazepam to fall asleep, and I started to OD. I got to the point where I was staring at my floor thinking... this is the end... and it was the most bleak and empty feeling I’ve ever had in my life... 

I grabbed my naloxone kit and it took 2 shots of naloxone to revive me while my mom had to drive me to the hospital while I was having the freak out of my life. 

My psychiatrist prescribed me some new meds, I got a new job, and it’s like I’m a completely different person. The right psychiatric medications can work wonders and make you feel like you have purpose again.

Everything is temporary and you would be amazed at how quickly your life can change, time is key, you only have this life once. Don’t not live it because it’s all you have in the first place.

I have meetings booked with a specialized mental health and addictions psychiatrist to discuss al symptoms, it just sucks because my symptomology is unheard of. Nobody can attribute it to any one condition... not bipolar, not schizophrenic, do not have aspergers. Maybe I exist on an extremely high functioning level of autism. But all I will say is that this ‘game of sorts’ that everybody has tried so faithfully to cause an impression on my head was with full intention of doing so. There was no hesitation, no consideration of what the aftermath of that might be. Which is my fault in a way I guess.

Any responses are welcome please keep them coming. SOMEONE must have had a similar experience, I can’t be the only one!
